management: Avoid moving tools from affected rows without sanitation
Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.climate_focus: Climate will not cure virus; keep canopy dry enough for scouting and reduce vector-favourable stagnant air.

management: Consider biological control or approved miticide per local protocol
Avoid repeated broad-spectrum sprays that remove predators
Tomato__Spider_Mites.climate_focus: Mites favour hot, dry canopies — avoid over-drying; raise RH moderately if crop and disease pressure allow.

visual_cues: Lesions on leaves and sometimes fruit
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.climate_focus: Lower RH and increase airflow; stop fogging / overhead wetting.

management: Follow local fungicide / cultural schedule if pressure rises
Tomato___Early_blight.climate_focus: Reduce prolonged high RH; increase venting after irrigation.

visual_cues: Rapid expansion in cool humid air
management: Treat as outbreak priority — isolate affected bay if possible
Remove and bag severely infected tissue
Escalate to agronomist for protectant programme
Tomato___Late_blight.climate_focus: Aggressively lower RH, open vents / fans, halt fogging, avoid leaf wetness.

management: Check condensation on inner roof / gutters
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.climate_focus: Primary lever is RH + ventilation; raise heating slightly at night if needed to dry air.

management: Keep drip lines from wetting foliage
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.climate_focus: Moderate RH reduction and continuous gentle airflow.

visual_cues: Fruit lesions possible in severe cases
management: Avoid prolonged leaf wetness after irrigation
Scout adjacent rows for early spread
Tomato___Target_Spot.climate_focus: Vent + fan to shorten wetness; avoid fogger cycles.

management: Do not use climate as a substitute for sanitation
Tomato_mosaic_virus.climate_focus: Keep environment stable for crop; focus on biosecurity rather than setpoint extremes.

visual_cues: No active lesion pattern above threshold
management: Keep current climate recipe unless sensors drift
Do not spray based on a healthy frame alone
Do not change climate from an empty scan
